# @bangbang93/opencode-aio

An [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) plugin that loads every plugin of the
[opencode-plugins](https://github.com/bangbang93/opencode-plugins) workspace, so one entry in `opencode.jsonc`
applies them all.

| Plugin | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`@bangbang93/opencode-comment-checker`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@bangbang93/opencode-comment-checker) | Makes the model justify or remove the comments it adds with `edit` and `write`. |
| [`@bangbang93/opencode-edit-error-recovery`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@bangbang93/opencode-edit-error-recovery) | Appends a reminder to a failed `edit` that tells the model to read the file before it tries again. |
| [`@bangbang93/opencode-bash-file-read-guard`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@bangbang93/opencode-bash-file-read-guard) | Blocks `cat`, `head` and `tail` so the model reads files with the `read` tool. |
| [`@bangbang93/opencode-write-existing-file-guard`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@bangbang93/opencode-write-existing-file-guard) | Blocks `write` to an existing file that the session has not read. |

## Install

Add the package to `plugins` in `opencode.jsonc`:

```jsonc
{
  "plugins": ["@bangbang93/opencode-aio@0.1.0"]
}
```

To run a checkout of the repository instead, point the entry at `packages/opencode-aio`.

## Behavior

- The bundle is a single plugin with the id `opencode-aio`. It sets up the bundled plugins in the order of the table,
  each with the context it would get on its own, so they behave as if they were listed one by one.
- Add `"-opencode-aio"` to the `plugins` array to turn all of them off. To leave one out, list the plugins you want
  one by one instead of the bundle.
- Do not list the bundle together with one of the bundled plugins, because that plugin would then run twice.

## Versions

The bundle depends on exact versions of the bundled plugins. A new release of one of them reaches the bundle with the
bundle's next release.

## License

MIT. The bundled plugins are MIT as well, and each ships a `NOTICE.md` that lists what it derives from.
